note: The chances dock DGAI draws today, as its adapter makes it: scripts/olumi-core/lib/model.mjs analysisViewOf at DGAI 6928d8e03 (poc/science-consumers, the base DGAI's step 2 builds on), run on each golden input with no AI (legacy Run facts: candidate core has no labels grammar). waits_on.text is DGAI's waitsOnCountWords. The View must say the same, word for word. The proposal golden is not here: while a change waits the adapter reads the saved version, the View the proposal. studio-members-first is studio with its membership aim placed first (built in the test from studio.input.json; review 00073): the Run is then about that aim, so no driver or most-likely line from the takings aim may show. Three more are built in the test by changing one record of a golden form and running it again, as scripts/golden-inputs.ts runs one (review 00073's bar: every rule the dock shows is pinned on a real Run): studio-takings-asked (the takings target asked, so that aim only waits and the Run's aim is the membership aim), bakery-limit-unmeasured (the budget limit without a measure: not checked, for the limit as a whole) and bakery-ovens-asked (the ovens added asked: the aim's waits and the options' blockers rest on it, and it is named once). The words slice adds three, built the same way: pricing-no-options (no live option, so not every option is withheld), pricing-unmoved-first (an aim on today's cups, which no option moves, placed first: every option is withheld on it while each has a chance on profit) and pricing-no-goals (no aim: no aim words and no lead line). Six rows (pricing, studio, bakery, european, app-launch, studio-members-first) were updated by hand on 3 Nov to the goldens regenerated at v3 45693d8, field by field with their causes (the commit lists them), not re-run through DGAI's adapter; a new waits-on item's code follows this file's convention (asked, unknown, waiting) and is not compared. Both updated by hand, since the View passes the fact's words through and only they changed. Three rows were updated by hand on 3 Nov for V3.1 PROVENANCE (one reliance rule): studio's and european's most_likely and studio-members-first's notes now carry the corrected basis of the facts they show (studio rests on Olumi's proposed workshop figure; european names Olumi's proposed horizon and settings), field by field from the golden inputs, not re-run through DGAI's adapter. pricing-unmoved-first's two withheld lines were updated by hand on 3 Nov (the View says a reason every option shares once, in run.shared_blockers): each card's line is now the mark "cannot be worked out yet · Sell at least 3,500 cups a month", as the core page marks it; the reason is said once, outside this file's fields, and is pinned in view.test.
